question_evidence_quote: Another duck eats only 13 pieces of the bread and the last duck eats 7 pieces of bread. There are 30 pieces of bread left in the water
violated_condition: The two specified duck portions and the leftover bread sum to 13 + 7 + 30 = 50 pieces.
error_description: The response correctly sets up the bread conservation equation, but then replaces 13 + 7 + 30 with 40 instead of 50 pieces. This incorrectly executes the written addition of the two ducks’ portions and the bread remaining in the water, producing an incorrect total.
